front.title: TSF Extensions to ANCP in CU Separation Broadband Networks

abstract.t: This document specifies a Traffic Steering Function (TSF) capability extension to the Access Node Control Protocol (ANCP), to discover and manage disaggregated user-plane (UP) functions in control/user plane separated networks, including the Access Network User Plane (AN-UP) and the Network Access Server User Plane (NAS-UP).
